analogy.rationale: Opioid receptors are Gi-coupled GPCRs that are barely expressed in these cell lines, so opioid antagonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest analogs are other GPCR antagonists and sigma receptor antagonists, which share some target overlap (SIGMAR1) but also act on poorly expressed receptors.
